purpose: P3 Option B dense-grid subset: 500 models drawn from the 1028-model P1 retained population.
derivation_procedure: 5. subset = numpy default_rng(seed).choice(sorted retained indices, 500, replace=False), then sorted
selection_independence: Uniform random draw over the sorted retained-index list. No phenotype, cycle length, threshold, drug response or outcome value is read by the selection procedure.
prefix_note: 89 of 500 drawn models have index < 940 (the historical contiguous prefix). Expected under uniform sampling: 91.4. The prefix was NOT used as a selection criterion; this count is reported, not imposed.
immutability: This seed and subset MUST NOT be redrawn on the basis of any dense-grid result.
